newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 27.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - February 27.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Universities, colleges to be allowed to confer bachelor's, master's and doctoral degrees for correspondence or promotion courses
Low-cost housing to be avilable soon
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Cabinet discusses impact of long holiday weekend; financial institutions, hospitals, customs to remain open on February 28 Memorial Day and Saturday
LIBERTY TIMES - Heavy fog disrupts air traffic
COMMERCIAL TIMES - State banks, customs not to close on Friday and Saturday despite newly decreed holiday weekend
National Health Insurance premium to be made deductible from business income tax
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Government institutions to open partially on Friday and Saturday
Cabinet asked to revise Labour Standards Law
